Evaluation Metric. Due to various topologies, an effective DoC attack must ensure that as many agents as possible enter a blocked state. To quantify this, we follow the attack success rate in jailbreak (Zou et al., 2023), and define Proportional Attack Success Rate (P-ASR) to measures the proportion of blocked agents in the LLM-MAS. Besides ef- fectiveness, we claim that efficiency is equally vi- tal. Therefore, we design the Peak Blocking Turn Number (PTN) , which evaluates how quickly the attack reaches its peak impact for the victim.

Evaluation Metric. Due to various topologies, an effective DoC attack must ensure that as many agents as possible enter a blocked state.
